item.tib: gtsang ma klu 'bum bsdus pa'i rgyal po
item.coloph: gtsang ma klu 'bum don bsdus chung ngu ces bya ba las / bcad pa'i le'u ste nyi shu lnga pa'o // gtsang ma klu 'bum don bsdus chung ngu zhes bya ba rdzogs so // bkra shis par shog
item.note: the no. 52 is wrongly labelled as p. no. "51". the front titles, on p. 2 etc., are given in zhang-zhung, sum-pa and tibetan languages. in some places we find, as well, some apparent samples of me-nyag (tangut) language, as on p. 6. the chapter heading titles have not been listed here. there are dum bu and bam po divisions in the text, which have not been noted here. at p. 13.2, it says that [ston-pa gshen-rab] preached the forty-two chapters of the klu 'bum (and apparently adding that here are to be found the first 22 of those chapters?). there is a very pertinent passage on the nine vehicles, and on the various divisions of the Word of gshen-rab on pp. 123 ff., which includes a kind of catalogue of the 'bum section. the 25 chapter titles of the present text correspond very closely to the chapter titles listed in ytkc, pp. 307-309. notice, however, that ytkc lists the main title as gtsang ma klu 'bum khra bo don 'dus. the present text is probably identifiable with the text in 25 chaps. listed in brgyud rim, p. 223, with the title gtsang ma klu 'bum don bsdus chung ngu.
